mechanism: Primidone is metabolized to phenobarbital which induces CYP3A4 and other enzymes, potentially reducing eslicarbazepine levels; additive CNS depression and increased risk of ataxia/dizziness also present.
action: Monitor for reduced eslicarbazepine efficacy; consider increasing eslicarbazepine dose or selecting alternative antiepileptic; assess for excessive CNS depression symptoms.
